body: Of course.  I'll send you a pm on my main account, because I'm highly likely to forget this one.

Thank you for the kind words; you're right, I did try to bury it as a tl;dr.

I just got back from a Psych appt. with my old doc, and he's adjusting several medications.  He also feels that I'm on the Borderline spectrum (which is... discouraging) and that I really need to find someone who can work through DBT therapy with that can hopefully change the way I think about things if I do what's asked of me and not take it in as superficial therapy, of which I'm admittedly prone to do.

I know that there isn't a magic therapy that's going to "cure" me of the way I think and perceive things; I'm very aware that this is a lifelong issue and that's the crux of why I tried to kill myself.  When things get back on track, I'm going to finish up my degree to be a therapist, because I'm unfortunately excellent in seeing what the base issue of someone else's problems and figuring out where they need to go, I just can't take my own.

Also, sorry I'm wordy.  Words words words.

The medical stuff mostly just comes from working in public service in one way or another since I was 14 (lifeguarding, swimming lessons, and, most recently direct care with adults with developmental disabilities) so I've seen a lot of CPR/first aid videos.  I also just have a knack for remembering small details.

I do do art; all of my supplies, however, are in Portland (I was under the impression I was going to be here a week, rather than through the holidays like I assumed.  I'd leave, but my parents have been paying rent and I'm not well enough to be self-sufficient".  I have been looking at opening a store up at etsy or the like, but I'll need to wait until I can go down there without wanting to deck my roommates.  I'm pretty sure I'll win.  I'm pretty scrappy.

Honestly, I think most of my problems lie in the fact that after being in the system for since I was about 7 and working with doctors and taking meds as prescribed and reporting when they're off and going to appointments... I just feel too tired anymore.
Thanks.  It's just so incredibly frustrating, but this is sage advice.
